name: Survey tile in Leo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.7 degrees south of the ecliptic in Leo, imaged by SPHEREx 13 times in 4 visits over 39 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 26 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 39 hours starting 2025-11-04, at wavelengths from 0.75 to 3.64 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
